_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. NOTE: this pipeline calls sec-form4-insider-tracker, whose own per-event charges also bill the buyer. The Form 4 child is EDGAR HTTP (no browser, no proxy) and the FDA stage is inline openFDA HTTP, so compute per run is tiny and these prices stay well above it. Free tier kept to 1 approval_confirmed so any run with billable rows covers compute.

watch.eventDescription: One FDA clearance or supplement with no insider buying in the window. Includes the product, FDA id number, decision date, FDA link, and the insider buy/sell tally.

accumulation.eventDescription: A major FDA approval (drug NDA/BLA or device PMA), or any FDA event with insider open-market buying in the window. Includes product, event detail, and the insider buy/sell counts and dollar values.

approval_confirmed.eventDescription: A recent major FDA approval (drug NDA/BLA or device PMA), optionally with net insider open-market buying in the window. An approval landing while insiders also buy. Includes full event and insider buy detail. The first approval confirmed per run is free so you can validate output.
